verdict.rationale: FireHydrant gives every incident a dedicated internal status page. Updates posted via `/fh update` or Command Center flow to that page, and for organization-public incidents it requires no auth or license to view. AI summaries are available to anyone in the Slack workspace without an account, can be tailored to stakeholder groups via Audiences, and can be pushed to a Slack channel when generated. Together these let stakeholders follow structured updates outside the war room. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented per-stakeholder subscribe mechanism (e.g., email or subscription to internal status pages), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
